action.objective: Retreat the light bishop to d1, escaping the queen check while keeping material balanced and the king shielded.
action.rationale: White is in check from the b1 queen; only three legal evasions exist. h5d1 is the sole commit_ready move: verified depth-3 exact score 152 (best of the three), safety complete (no mate in one), tactical_refutation and checking_chain_refutation both not_found. Ke2/Kd2 score -152/-172 (upper bounds, possibly worse) and Kd2 carries a recent-move penalty. Bd1 keeps the bishop active on the c2-g6 diagonal and the king on e1 with no forced follow-up.
